trust_assumptions: repository administrator and protected oracle owner independent of candidate writer
runner, verifier, workflow and evidence transport integrity
authorized scientific policy validity not proved by signatures

gates.name: claim transition
gates.reject: mission universal but only local evidence; obligations dropped between commissions
gates.proof: protected prior claim/obligations plus independently verified capability delta

gates.name: oracle independence
gates.reject: candidate supplies expected set or matching self-selected pin
gates.proof: policy digest resolved from separately protected immutable ref; policy update independently approved before run

gates.name: shape and frontier
gates.reject: three renamed fixtures; manual selected operation list; duplicate occurrence; outcome-derived eligibility
gates.proof: independent structural edge-class cover and pre-outcome finite operation multiset

gates.name: actual native execution
gates.reject: native booleans, fabricated trace, fake owner, production imports test fixture
gates.proof: trusted runner resolves candidate and imported owner bytes; source-backed C11/I03/I05/Batch actual events and object refs

gates.name: identity conservation
gates.proof: K at request, fact, release and actual consumer values-read matches or explicitly governed transformation

gates.name: total state and no drop
gates.reject: UNKNOWN->NA; unsupported->positive; count-preserving operation swap; pending->done
gates.proof: disjoint scientific and execution partitions; exact identity anti-joins; valid null/zero positive controls

gates.name: mutation and cold replay
gates.reject: cached positive, import-error masquerading as science refusal, duplicate counted receipt
gates.proof: same named consumer assertion baseline PASS -> meaningful mutation FAIL -> cold restore PASS; uninterrupted/resume equality

gates.name: trusted promotion enforcement
gates.reject: forged/stale run artifact; candidate changes checker; spoofed status context
gates.proof: authenticated run provenance bound to repo/candidate/tree/policy/workflow/runtime digest and nonce; required check from authorized verifier only

gates.name: original35 and global F1-F8
gates.reject: 35 synthetic names, source grants without execution, one canary, context as structural, synthetic temporal pair
gates.proof: all35 exact source/edition/format/rights and operation measurements plus F6 multi-field/F7 comparable pairs/F8 unchanged permitted consumer; independent N11 adjudication

event_schema.origin: trusted supervisor or instrumented protected harness; candidate stdout alone never authoritative
event_schema.auth: CI attestation bound to authorized repository/workflow identity or independently authenticated equivalent; verifier checks issuer/audience/digests/freshness/replay

shape_basis.coverage: independent set-cover over actual exercised edge classes; shape label/hash alone insufficient

forbidden: privileged execution of candidate code in policy checkout
acceptance of expected outputs copied from candidate
claim of original permission from sourcefree tests
limitations: No finite fixture set proves arbitrary unseen semantics
Authenticated events do not prove scientific authority
Repository admin/root compromise outside stated threat model
Protected deployment and actual native runner NOT_RUN
